notes: Semantic/presentation boundary baseline 1a9e8b377, measured by Linux CI run 40113172363 with Rust 1.95.0, wasm-pack 0.15.0, Binaryen 133 and wasm-tools 1.261.0. Each raw, stripped, gzip and Brotli ceiling is its measured value plus 3%, rounded upward to 1,000 bytes. All six canonical profiles are reassessed, including lower full/render ceilings after math becomes explicit. Web uses wasm-tools strip --all on final assembled npm WASM; Typst retains release wasm-opt -Oz and strip. Feature recipes, compression and functional gates are unchanged by this budget decision. Downloaded Web artifacts, source/closure analysis, exact measurements and old/new limits are recorded in docs/performance/semantic_wasm_budget_2026-10-25.md. This does not establish equal-capability full/render savings, latency or memory acceptance, or U1-U9 completion.
